plain: To fill up again; to supply anew

webster.text: To fill; to stock with numbers or abundance.

example.quote: When we have paid all the gold and silver we could to replenish the congressional coffers, here they ask lor confidence.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 17, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
